# Normative test vectors for NormalizeTag and its key. See SPEC.md §9.
#
# Format: one vector per line, three Go-quoted strings separated by spaces:
#
#   <input> <normalized tag (SPEC.md §4)> <key (SPEC.md §5)>   # comment
#
# Strings use Go strconv.QuoteToASCII quoting: printable ASCII is literal, every
# other code point is written as \uNNNN or \UNNNNNNNN, and invalid UTF-8 as \xNN,
# so visually identical inputs (e.g. composed vs decomposed é) stay distinct.
# Every expected value was produced by dd-go's model.NormalizeTag.
# Expected values are never edited by hand: they are regenerated from dd-go by a
# harness outside this repository, because dd-go is not public.

# Basics
"" "" ""  # empty tag stays empty (dropped by the intake)
"env:prod" "env:prod" "env"  # already normalized
"Env:Prod" "env:prod" "env"  # §4 B2 ASCII uppercase lowercased, in the value too
"region:us-east-1" "region:us-east-1" "region"  # §4 B6 '-' kept
"path:/var/log/app.log" "path:/var/log/app.log" "path"  # §4 B6 '/' and '.' kept
"a" "a" "a"  # single letter
":" ":" ""  # §4 B3 ':' alone is a tag
"::" "::" ""  # §4 B3 every ':' is kept
"a:b:c" "a:b:c" "a"  # §5 only the first ':' separates the key
"url:https://example.com/x?q=1&r=2" "url:https://example.com/x_q_1_r_2" "url"  # §4 B8 '?', '=', '&' become '_'

# Start of tag (§4 B5)
"1abc" "abc" "abc"  # leading digit skipped
"123" "" ""  # only digits: empty
"_foo" "foo" "foo"  # leading '_' skipped
"__foo__" "foo" "foo"  # leading run skipped, trailing run collapsed then stripped
"-foo" "foo" "foo"  # leading '-' skipped
".foo" "foo" "foo"  # leading '.' skipped
"/foo" "foo" "foo"  # leading '/' skipped
" foo" "foo" "foo"  # leading space skipped
"\U0001f363sushi" "sushi" "sushi"  # leading emoji skipped
":foo" ":foo" ""  # ':' can start a tag: key is empty
"123:foo" ":foo" ""  # digits skipped, then ':' starts the tag: key is empty
"1:2:foo" ":2:foo" ""  # ':' starts the tag, so the digit after it is kept
"_:foo" ":foo" ""  # '_' skipped, ':' starts the tag
"\x80abc" "abc" "abc"  # leading invalid byte skipped
"\u0663abc" "abc" "abc"  # leading non-ASCII digit (Nd) skipped

# Underscores and other characters (§4 B8, §4 finish)
"a b" "a_b" "a_b"  # space becomes '_'
"a,b\\c" "a_b_c" "a_b_c"  # ',' and '\' become '_'
"a_b" "a_b" "a_b"  # single '_' kept
"a__b" "a_b" "a_b"  # '_' run collapsed
"a!@#b" "a_b" "a_b"  # run of other characters collapsed to one '_'
"a_" "a" "a"  # trailing '_' stripped
"a__" "a" "a"  # trailing run stripped
"a._b" "a._b" "a._b"  # '_' after '.' is kept (unlike metric names)
"a_.b" "a_.b" "a_.b"  # '_' before '.' is kept (unlike metric names)
"a_:b" "a_:b" "a_"  # '_' before ':' is not trailing: kept, key ends in '_'
"a__:b" "a_:b" "a_"  # '_' run before ':' collapsed, key ends in '_'
"a:_b" "a:_b" "a"  # '_' after ':' kept
"a:b_" "a:b" "a"  # trailing '_' in the value stripped
"a:" "a:" "a"  # trailing ':' kept
"a:_" "a:" "a"  # trailing '_' after ':' stripped, ':' kept
"a: " "a:" "a"  # trailing space becomes '_' then is stripped

# Digits (§3.2 Digit, §4 B7)
"a123" "a123" "a123"  # ASCII digits kept
"a\u0661\u0662\u0663" "a\u0661\u0662\u0663" "a\u0661\u0662\u0663"  # Arabic-Indic digits (Nd) kept verbatim
"a\u00b2" "a" "a"  # superscript two is No, not Nd: becomes '_', stripped
"a\u2163" "a" "a"  # Roman numeral is Nl, not Nd: becomes '_', stripped
"a\u00b2b" "a_b" "a_b"  # No in the middle becomes '_'

# Letters and lowercasing (§3.2 Letter, §3.3, §4 B4)
"Caf\u00e9:\u00dcn\u00efcode" "caf\u00e9:\u00fcn\u00efcode" "caf\u00e9"  # non-ASCII letters lowercased and kept
"\u00c0\u00c9\u00ce" "\u00e0\u00e9\u00ee" "\u00e0\u00e9\u00ee"  # Latin-1 uppercase lowercased
"\u65e5\u672c\u8a9e:\u5024" "\u65e5\u672c\u8a9e:\u5024" "\u65e5\u672c\u8a9e"  # Lo letters kept
"\u00aa\u02b0" "\u00aa\u02b0" "\u00aa\u02b0"  # Lo and Lm letters kept
"\u0130stanbul" "istanbul" "istanbul"  # U+0130 simple-lowercases to 'i' (full mapping would add U+0307)
"\u212a" "k" "k"  # Kelvin sign lowercases to ASCII 'k' (3 bytes to 1)
"\u01c5" "\u01c6" "\u01c6"  # titlecase Lt lowercases
"\u03a3\u0391\u03a3" "\u03c3\u03b1\u03c3" "\u03c3\u03b1\u03c3"  # Greek capital sigma always becomes σ (no final-sigma rule)
"\u1e9e" "\u00df" "\u00df"  # capital sharp s lowercases to ß
"\u00df" "\u00df" "\u00df"  # lowercase sharp s unchanged (no uppercase/fold)
"\u017f" "\u017f" "\u017f"  # long s is lowercase already and unchanged
"\u2c65" "\u2c65" "\u2c65"  # U+2C65 is lowercase and unchanged
"\u023a" "\u2c65" "\u2c65"  # U+023A lowercases to U+2C65 (2 bytes to 3)
"a\u0301" "a" "a"  # combining mark (Mn) is not a letter: '_', stripped
"e\u0301:x" "e_:x" "e_"  # decomposed é: mark becomes '_', kept before ':'
"\u00e9:x" "\u00e9:x" "\u00e9"  # precomposed é kept: no Unicode normalization (NFC) is applied
"\U00010400" "\U00010428" "\U00010428"  # Deseret capital lowercases (4 bytes)
"\U0001d400" "\U0001d400" "\U0001d400"  # mathematical bold capital A has no lowercase mapping

# Invalid UTF-8 and U+FFFD (§3.1)
"a\xffb" "a_b" "a_b"  # invalid byte becomes '_'
"a\xff\xfeb" "a_b" "a_b"  # each invalid byte decodes separately; run collapsed
"\xff" "" ""  # only an invalid byte: empty
"a\xc3" "a" "a"  # truncated sequence at end: '_', stripped
"a\xed\xa0\x80b" "a_b" "a_b"  # encoded surrogate is invalid: three U+FFFD
"a\ufffdb" "a_b" "a_b"  # literal U+FFFD is not a letter: '_'

# Output length (§4 step 1)
"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa" "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa" "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"  # exactly MaxLength bytes
"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa" "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa" "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"  # truncated to 200 bytes
"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa_b" "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa" "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"  # '_' is the 200th byte, then stripped: 199 bytes
"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa\u00e9" "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa\u00e9" "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa\u00e9"  # 2-byte letter at byte 199: 201 bytes
"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa\U00010400" "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa\U00010428" "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa\U00010428"  # 4-byte letter at byte 199: 203 bytes (MaxOutputLength)
"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa\u212a" "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaak" "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaak"  # 3-byte input lowercasing to 1 byte
"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa\u00e9" "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa" "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"  # nothing appended once 200 bytes are emitted
"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa:x" "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa:" "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"  # ':' at byte 199 is emitted: key is 199 bytes
"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa:x" "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa" "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"  # ':' after 200 bytes is never emitted: no value
"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa_:x" "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa" "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"  # '_' at byte 199 fills the buffer; ':' never emitted; '_' stripped
